claims.claim: Microplastics have been detected in human blood and in tissues including the lungs, placenta, brain, and blood vessels.
Finding them in the body shows exposure, but doesn’t by itself prove they cause disease.
The health evidence is still limited, and many proposed effects come from animal or laboratory studies rather than studies that can establish harm in people.
